summary: iter69 — Hot Shot TMS multi-tenant white-label platform. Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E. 29/30 backend tests pass. All critical UI flows work: tenant isolation, portal auth, loads/invoice/carriers CRUD, per-tenant branding refresh, dispatcher role-gating (Team/Settings hidden), Stripe checkout redirect to checkout.stripe.com, Tenant Command panel provision/suspend/activate/delete, public /api/hotshot/status, ROI calculator, Solo Arcade (all 3 games), demo video card. ONE REAL BACKEND BUG: brute-force lockout unreliable through k8s ingress (uses request.client.host which rotates across pods) — lockout does not fire within 9 attempts in some runs.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout uses `request.client.host` as part of the identifier. Through the k8s ingress load-balancer the client IP visible to the app rotates across ingress pods, so the per-identifier counter resets and the 5-strike lockout is inconsistent. Observed lockout firing after 7-9 attempts (variable) rather than the spec of 5 -> 429 on 6th. Should use X-Forwarded-For (first hop) or slug+email only as identifier.

ui_bugs.issue: When a dispatcher user directly navigates to /t/<slug>/app/team or /app/settings, the route still renders (URL stays the same, page appears blank because the Team/Settings components require admin scope but frontend doesn't redirect). Backend correctly returns 403 for admin-only endpoints so no data leaks — but UX would be better with a redirect to /app or a friendly access-denied screen.

issues: Console logs 3-6 401s on initial page load — likely from an axios call fired before the token is set. Harmless functionally but noisy for observability.

action_items: Fix brute-force identifier: replace `request.client.host` with X-Forwarded-For header parse (first IP) OR just use slug+email — the current implementation is effectively bypassable in a k8s environment and the auto-test proves lockout does not reliably fire within 9 attempts.
Optional: frontend guard for dispatcher hitting /app/team, /app/settings directly by URL — redirect to /app when role != admin.

rca_brute_force_bug: Reproduction: repeatedly POST /api/t/{slug}/auth/login with a wrong password >= 6 times in quick succession. Expected: 6th attempt returns 429. Actual: 429 fires sometimes after 7, 8, or 9 attempts. Root cause: routes/tenant_platform.py:284 constructs the login-attempt identifier as `f"{request.client.host}:{slug}:{email}"`. In the preview environment (Kubernetes ingress -> multiple backend pods) `request.client.host` is the ingress pod's IP, which rotates. So the counter is split across N pods and each needs to hit >=5 individually. Mitigation: (a) parse X-Forwarded-For header (first IP) so the identifier reflects the real user IP, (b) store attempts under `slug:email` only, dropping IP (slightly less DDoS-friendly but far more predictable), or (c) use a Redis-backed shared counter with the real forwarded IP.
